fe914892fc2a755f.triage_reason: DeltaTable.to_pyarrow_table first positional argument is the column projection; keyword-only rewrite is style.

d509240505d56233.triage_reason: Missing Silver reference table returns [] so destructive FK reconcile treats every source row as an orphan.

dd39ebae9d947219.triage_reason: if arrow_data treats an empty table as missing and drops schema/records.

77ac90e0c2cd7ea4.triage_reason: Missing timestamp uses assert instead of fail-closed ValueError.

09474ee2221a74b6.triage_reason: Network-drive YAML load already fail-closes via Future.result(timeout=); OS-level kill is an enhancement.
